texts: In spring the river flooded the fields. The council inspected the old bridge and agreed to repair it before the school reopened. The work began on Monday.
A small workshop measures energy use every hour. Explain how to compare two machines fairly when they have different idle times and rates of production.
海边的小镇在冬天十分安静。渔船清晨出港，傍晚带着鱼回到码头。学校的学生记录了天气和潮汐，并比较了不同季节的数据。
